topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the lecture framework, learning outcomes, and the multistep mutation progression underlying the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Growth Factor Independence and Proliferative Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic mutations in pathways like Wnt and receptor tyrosine kinases drive sustained proliferative signaling.

topics.label: Block in Terminal Differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how failures in terminal differentiation arrest cell maturation and promote malignancy in hematopoietic and intestinal tissues.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how cancer cells resist programmed cell death through alterations in p53 regulation and the mitochondrial apoptosis machinery.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address telomere shortening, TERT reactivation mechanisms, and the p53-dependent stress pathways governing cellular senescence.

topics.label: Deregulated Cellular Metabolism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the metabolic alterations of cancer cells, including aerobic glycolysis, metabolic rewiring, and the role of oncometabolites.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the angiogenic switch and blood vessel recruitment required for supplying oxygen and nutrients to growing tumors.

topics.label: Metastasis and Systemic Dissemination
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the multi-step invasion process, circulatory spread, metastatic inefficiency, and genomic duplication associated with metastatic tumors.

topics.label: Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This topic concludes the lecture with a summary of hallmark integration and guidance on further reading.
